guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.northern_.ja: 芝屋根の木造の長い館。囲炉裏を囲む長椅子、鍛冶場と小さな舟屋。雪国の素朴なギルドハウス。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.northern_.en: A long timber hall under a turf roof: benches round the hearth, a smithy and a little boathouse. The simple home of a guild from the snowy north.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.mushroom_.ja: 巨大な茸の中に部屋がある不思議な隠れ家。胞子の灯りがともり、苔の小径が茸の間を結ぶ。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.mushroom_.en: A whimsical hideaway with rooms inside giant mushrooms, lit by glowing spores, mossy paths winding between them.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ancient_r.ja: 苔むした古代神殿の跡を手直しした拠点。崩れた列柱の中庭と、地下に眠る宝物庫。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ancient_r.en: A mossy temple ruin made into a home: a courtyard of broken colonnades and a treasure vault sleeping underground.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.pirate_sh.ja: 入り江に停泊する海賊船がまるごとギルドハウス。甲板で訓練、船倉が倉庫、船長室で作戦会議。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.pirate_sh.en: A pirate ship moored in a cove is the whole house: train on deck, stow the loot in the hold, plan in the captain's cabin.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.flower_gl.ja: 四季の花が咲き誇る硝子の温室。噴水のある花園でお茶会を、蔓薔薇の回廊でひと休み。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.flower_gl.en: A glass conservatory full of flowers in bloom: tea parties by the fountain garden, rest under the rose arcade.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dwarven_f.ja: 山の中に掘られた坑道の工房。燃え盛る溶鉱炉、きらめく鉱脈、トロッコの線路が奥へ続く。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dwarven_f.en: Workshops dug into the mountain: roaring furnaces, glittering ore veins and mine tracks running deep inside.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.desert_pa.ja: オアシスに建つ白砂の離宮。青いタイルの中庭と水路、ヤシの木陰の涼しい回廊。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.desert_pa.en: A sandstone retreat at an oasis: a blue-tiled courtyard with water channels and cool arcades in the palm shade.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.observato.ja: 丸屋根の天文台。巨大な望遠鏡と天球儀、星図を描いた床、星座を眺める屋上庭園。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.observato.en: A domed observatory with a great telescope, an armillary sphere, a star-map floor and a roof garden under the constellations.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.japanese_.ja: 瓦屋根と縁側の武家屋敷。枯山水と錦鯉の池泉庭園、道場と茶室、竹林の小径。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.japanese_.en: A tiled-roof mansion with verandas: a rock garden and a koi pond, a dojo, a tea room and a path through the bamboo.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.great_tre.ja: 森の大樹の幹をくり抜いた館。根元の広間から枝の上の見晴らし台へ、吊り橋が結ぶ。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.great_tre.en: A hall carved into the trunk of a giant tree: from the hall among the roots up to lookouts in the branches, linked by rope bridges.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sage_libr.ja: 吹き抜けの書架が天井まで続く大図書館。静かな閲覧室、錬金術の研究室、星の書斎。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sage_libr.en: Bookshelves soaring to the ceiling round a great atrium: quiet reading rooms, an alchemy laboratory and a study under the stars.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.jungle_te.ja: 密林に眠る階段ピラミッド。黄金の祭壇の間、滝の流れる中庭、蔦に覆われた回廊。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.jungle_te.en: A stepped pyramid asleep in the jungle: a hall of golden altars, a courtyard with a waterfall, vine-covered galleries.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.gothic_ca.ja: 月夜に佇む黒い聖堂。薔薇窓のステンドグラス、蝋燭の回廊、鐘楼からの夜景。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.gothic_ca.en: A dark cathedral under the moon: rose windows of stained glass, candle-lit cloisters and the night view from the bell tower.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.coral_hal.ja: 海の底の珊瑚の宮殿。硝子の天蓋越しに魚の群れが泳ぎ、真珠の光が広間を照らす。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.coral_hal.en: A palace of coral on the sea floor: shoals of fish swim past the glass domes and pearls light the halls.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.volcanic_.ja: 溶岩の流れる火口の砦。黒曜石の城壁、灼熱の鍛錬場、溶岩を見下ろす司令塔。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.volcanic_.en: A fortress in a volcano's crater: lava channels, obsidian walls, a scorching training yard and a war room over the lava.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ice_castl.ja: 氷と雪でできた尖塔の城。凍てついた大広間、氷の庭園、オーロラを望む塔。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.ice_castl.en: A castle of ice and snow with crystal spires: a frozen great hall, an ice garden and towers under the aurora.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dragon_la.ja: 古竜の眠る巨大な洞窟。竜の骨の大広間、溶岩の川、山と積まれた財宝。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.dragon_la.en: A vast cavern where an ancient dragon sleeps: a hall of dragon bones, a river of lava and a mountain of treasure.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.arcane_to.ja: 浮遊する魔法陣に囲まれた魔導の塔。螺旋階段が魔導書の書庫と星の研究室を結ぶ。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.arcane_to.en: A mage tower ringed by floating sigils: a spiral stair links the grimoire library and the starlit study.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sky_templ.ja: 雲の上に浮かぶ白と金の神殿。浮島を結ぶ橋と、滝の流れ落ちる天空の庭園。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.sky_templ.en: A white-and-gold temple floating above the clouds: bridges between islands and sky gardens with falling waters.

guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.marble_pa.ja: 白亜の大理石と金で飾られた宮殿。玉座の間、舞踏会場、噴水と迷路の庭園。
guildhouse.eternalrealm.design.marble_pa.en: A palace of white marble and gold: a throne hall, a ballroom and gardens of fountains and hedges.

npc.eternalrealm.guild_estates.ja: ギルドハウス仲介人 セレスタン

message.eternalrealm.guildhouse.error.no.ja: ギルドに入っていません。
